verdict.rationale: Avalara's Exemption Certificate Management (ECM/CertCapture) is documented to collect, validate, and store exemption certificates in one place, and AvaTax separately supports 'exemption logic' at calculation time, suggesting the pieces exist. However, the evidence never explicitly documents expiry tracking or the automatic linkage/application of a stored certificate during a live tax calculation call. missing for 10: explicit expiry-tracking documentation, explicit description of automatic certificate application at transaction/calc time linking ECM to AvaTax calculation.
